About the Scholarship

LAWGID is a one-year LL.M. in Law and Gender, Intersectionality and Diversity hosted at the Union University School of Law in Belgrade. The programme trains lawyers and social-science graduates to work on gender-sensitive legal reform, anti-discrimination practice and equality bodies across Europe and beyond.

LAWGID is a one-year LL.M. in Law and Gender, Intersectionality and Diversity hosted at the Union University School of Law in Belgrade. The programme trains lawyers and social-science graduates to work on gender-sensitive legal reform, anti-discrimination practice and equality bodies across Europe and beyond.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised LL.M. at the intersection of law, gender studies and diversity policy
  • Taught in English in Belgrade with an international teaching team
  • Designed for careers in NGOs, equality bodies, international organisations and academia
  • Application form, documents list and fee information available on the dedicated application page

Who Should Apply

The programme targets law graduates and professionals from adjacent fields such as political science, sociology or human rights practice. English proficiency and a short motivation statement are part of the standard file.

Funding and Costs

Tuition and any fee reductions are described on the programme's application page; scholarship places depend on the current call. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit the online application form on the official site and follow the document checklist provided there, since calls can differ slightly between cycles. Key deadline information: Rolling/annual cycle — current closing date published on the application page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Union University School of Law, Belgrade

The Union University School of Law in Belgrade runs the LAWGID LL.M. in Law and Gender, Intersectionality and Diversity. The faculty combines Serbian legal scholarship with international guest teaching on equality law and gender-responsive legal practice.

Official website: https://lawgid.ius.bg.ac.rs

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Rolling admission rounds - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
